instruction:
Two-Storey Townhouse IFC Shell

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a metric IFC4 two-storey townhouse shell and save the required output as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc, and /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 4 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 3 IfcSlab entities, 1 IfcDoor, 4 IfcWindow entities, 6 IfcOpeningElement entities, 6 IfcRelVoidsElement relationships, and 5 IfcRelFillsElement relationships.
4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities.
5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
6. The IfcBuildingStorey names are exactly Ground Floor and First Floor, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only; Ground Floor has Elevation 0.00 m and First Floor has Elevation 3.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
7. The IfcSpace names are exactly GF Living, GF Kitchen, FF Bedroom, and FF Bath, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
8. GF Living is assigned to Ground Floor and has clear plan dimensions 3.60 m by 3.20 m, GF Kitchen is assigned to Ground Floor and has clear plan dimensions 2.40 m by 3.20 m, FF Bedroom is assigned to First Floor and has clear plan dimensions 3.60 m by 4.00 m, and FF Bath is assigned to First Floor and has clear plan dimensions 2.40 m by 2.00 m; each space dimension may be in either X/Y orientation with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
9. Each IfcSpace has geometry height 2.80 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
10. The slabs are named exactly Ground Slab, First Floor Slab, and Roof Slab, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only; Ground Slab is assigned to Ground Floor, and First Floor Slab and Roof Slab are assigned to First Floor.
11. Each slab has plan dimensions 6.40 m by 4.40 m in either X/Y orientation and thickness 0.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.08 m for plan dimensions and +/-0.05 m for thickness.
12. The single door has OverallWidth 0.90 m with tolerance +/-0.08 m and fills exactly one IfcOpeningElement that voids an IfcWall.
13. The 4 windows each have OverallWidth 1.20 m with tolerance +/-0.08 m, and each window fills exactly one IfcOpeningElement that voids an IfcWall.
14. Exactly 1 IfcOpeningElement has no filling relationship and voids the slab named First Floor Slab.
15. Each wall has height 3.00 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m and plan thickness 0.20 m with tolerance +/-0.04 m.
16. All spaces, walls, slabs, the door, and windows are spatially assigned to either Ground Floor or First Floor.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
